item.title: Team Liquid distance themselves from fighting games as Nephew and Shadow20z become free agents
item.description: <p>In <a href="https://x.com/teamliquid/status/2008648029344330042">a recent X post</a>, Team Liquid announced that two of their players have now left their roster.</p> <p>While this is something that happens a lot in competitive gaming and with various sponsors, the notable fact here is that as Street Fighter player Nephew and Tekken competitor Shadow20z leave Team Liquid, it leaves them with no fighting game players left on their team roster.</p>

item.title: Capcom running New Year's survey that offers a special wallpaper with a new look at Ingrid in Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>Capcom has been doing quite well for themselves in recent years, and they're looking to keep that momentum going moving into 2026 now.</p> <p>The company recently put together an end of year / New Year's survey to get some feedback from the fans.</p>

item.title: Crazy ending to a Super Smash Bros. Ultimate tournament set sees Luigi winning with clever usage of his taunt
item.description: <p>Luigi will forever go down in Super Smash Bros. history for having the first instance of a taunt capable of dealing damage against opponents. He's had this trait since Super Smash Bros. for the Nintendo 64.</p> <p>Upon usage, Luigi will bashfully kick along the ground. It has a fixed knockback that's capable of spiking opponents that cling to the stage even when they're at 0% damage.</p>

item.title: Winning with only projectiles is no easy feat in Street Fighter 6, but fighting game legend Ryan Hart pulled it off
item.description: <p>One of the most classic things in fighting games is winning through just pure zoning and one of the earliest posterchildren of this phenomenon is Sagat, most specifically Old Sagat in Super Street Fighter 2: Turbo.</p> <p>In modern fighting games, projectiles are usually considerably less oppressive and Street Fighter 6 is definitely no exception to this rule. Which is why seeing an old school player pull off a win with only projectiles feels like quite a novelty to watch.</p>

item.title: Alex teaser trailer released for Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>While <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> fans have been hungry to get more content into the game, they are now at least getting a whiff of what's to come.</p> <p>Capcom just released the official teaser trailer for Alex in Street Fighter 6.</p>

item.title: Fist of the North Star's Kenshiro seemingly teased for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
item.description: <p>Well, this is a bit unexpected, but it appears as though we may now know another character who could be on their way to Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves — and he'd be a very unexpected guest.</p> <p>SNK just dropped a very interesting teaser animation with no explanation, but the implication seems pretty clear.</p>

item.title: 2026 fighting game guide: There's a crazy amount of new titles, updates and DLC on the way this year
item.description: <p>Fighting game players have had a lot of choices on their plate to pick from lately in terms of titles and content, and there's plenty more on the way too.</p> <p>2026 is shaping up to be another big year for fighting games, but what all is coming to the grand stage to look forward to?</p>
